candidates.transcript_evidence: This is going to be discussing a movie called Hachi, A Dog's Tale.
candidates.description: 提出讨论电影《忠犬八公》

candidates.transcript_evidence: Are you familiar with this film?
candidates.description: 询问是否熟悉这部电影

candidates.transcript_evidence: So I'll just explain sort of the premise of the film.
So it is based on a true story, and it centers around the strong bond between an Akita dog, whose name is Hachi, and his owner, Professor Parker.
candidates.description: 说明电影基于真实故事，讲述秋田犬八公与主人帕克教授之间的深厚感情

candidates.transcript_evidence: Now, unfortunately, Professor Parker passes away unexpectedly from a heart attack whilst he's at a train station.
candidates.description: 陈述帕克教授在火车站因心脏病突发去世

candidates.transcript_evidence: And Hachi continues to wait for his owner, Parker, at the train station every day.
candidates.description: 描述八公每天在火车站等待主人

candidates.transcript_evidence: Eventually, Parker's wife... I know, it's quite sad.
candidates.description: 提到帕克妻子时的感慨，承认故事伤感

candidates.transcript_evidence: Eventually, Parker's wife, Kate, she moves away from the town because of her grief.
candidates.description: 陈述帕克妻子凯特因悲伤搬离小镇

candidates.transcript_evidence: And so we're now going to watch a scene from the movie that takes place many years later, after Parker dies, where Kate is reunited with Hachi at the train station.
candidates.description: 说明将要观看多年后凯特在火车站与八公重逢的场景

candidates.transcript_evidence: It's a really powerful moment that highlights the loyalty and bond between Hachi and Parker.
candidates.description: 评价这一刻展示了八公的忠诚及与主人的纽带

candidates.transcript_evidence: It's a really powerful moment that highlights the loyalty and bond between Hachi and his owner.
candidates.description: 再次评价这一刻强调忠诚与纽带

candidates.transcript_evidence: And so are you ready to watch this together?
candidates.description: 询问对方是否准备好一起观看

candidates.transcript_evidence: That will just come on the screen shortly.
